title: Freight broker document digitization: how to manage files on your Mac
metaTitle: Freight broker document digitization: fix manual workflows on Mac
description: Stop manual data entry and document chaos. Learn how freight broker document digitization saves time, reduces errors, and keeps your Mac workflow fast.
intro: Freight broker document digitization is the process of moving away from manual, paper-based, or email-heavy file handling to structured digital workflows. If you spend hours each day downloading attachments and re-keying data into your TMS, you are losing money on administrative overhead.
tldr: Manual document processing costs mid-size forwarders up to $280,000 annually in errors and delays.
Automation reduces manual data entry by up to 80% and slashes processing time by 61%.
Use native macOS tools like Finder tags and Spotlight to organize files without extra software.
Avoid legacy Windows software that requires Java wrappers or virtualization, as it often freezes on macOS.
Lazur helps you dictate data, organize files by voice, and research document automation tools while you work.

blocks.text: The cost of manual document management

Freight brokerage is document-heavy. You handle bills of lading, commercial invoices, and packing lists for every load. When you manage these manually, you act as a data relay rather than a logistics expert. This is where the costs add up. Every manual entry is a chance for a typo. A single digit wrong in a zip code or weight can lead to customs holds or billing corrections.

The primary cause of document chaos is fragmented systems. You likely have information scattered across Gmail, local folders, and your TMS. When you need to find a specific Proof of Delivery, you waste time searching across these silos. Legacy systems built for Windows often force you to use virtualization software like Parallels. This makes your Mac perform poorly and adds complexity to simple tasks.

items: Manual data entry: Re-keying zip codes and weights from emails.
System fragmentation: Information trapped in email threads instead of the TMS.
Legacy software: Using Windows-only tools on a Mac creates performance bottlenecks.
High error rate: Human input errors often exceed 1% per document.

blocks.text: You do not need an expensive software suite to start improving your document management. Start by using what is already on your Mac. Use Finder tags to label documents by status, such as 'Pending' or 'Invoiced'. Use Spotlight to find files instantly by content, not just file name. If you use Gmail, create specific labels for different stages of the shipping process to keep your inbox clean.
Use the ⌘ + Space shortcut to open Spotlight. Type a partial file name or even a word inside a PDF to find documents without opening folders.
blocks.title: Use Spotlight for speed

blocks.text: How Lazur helps with document management

Lazur is a voice assistant for your Mac that helps you manage these tasks without taking your hands off the keyboard. You can ask Lazur to find a specific document, dictate notes into your TMS, or research new automation tools. Lazur sees your screen and points at the buttons you need to click, which helps when you are learning a new web-based TMS.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with my TMS?
faq.answer: Lazur works with any web-based TMS running in Chrome or Safari. It does not integrate directly with the software but can point at elements on your screen or help you dictate data into fields.

faq.question: Is my freight data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur only sees your screen and listens to your voice while you hold the activation shortcut. No data is stored or used to train AI models.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur on Windows?
faq.answer: No. Lazur is built exclusively for macOS.
